# teams_online_voicemail_validation_configuration (Resource)

Manages the OnlineVoicemailValidationConfiguration configuration via Set-CsOnlineVoicemailValidationConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `audio_file_validation_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -AudioFileValidationEnabled parameter.
- `audio_file_validation_uri` (String) Maps to the -AudioFileValidationUri parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
